title: Abstract Algebra: Theory and Applications
institution: Open textbook published by the author at judsonbooks.org (PreTeXt source on GitHub, twjudson/aata)
description: Open undergraduate algebra textbook, revised annually. Chapters 1–15 cover preliminaries, the integers, groups, cyclic groups, permutation groups, cosets and Lagrange's theorem, cryptography, coding theory, isomorphisms, normal subgroups and factor groups, homomorphisms, matrix groups and symmetry, the structure of groups, group actions and the Sylow theorems; chapters 16–23 cover rings, polynomials, domains, lattices, vector spaces, fields and Galois theory. The HTML edition gives every section its own page with numbered, anchored statements.
rightsNotes: The HTML edition's colophon states: 'Permission is granted to copy, distribute and/or modify this document under the terms of the GNU Free Documentation License, Version 1.2 or any later version published by the Free Software Foundation; with no Invariant Sections, no Front-Cover Texts, and no Back-Cover Texts.' Copyright line: '©1997–2026 Thomas W. Judson, Robert A. Beezer'. Corniversity may import the HTML for private study and citation; any Corniversity artefact that reproduces substantial text from the book would itself fall under the GFDL and must say so.

The site landing page carries a generic footer 'Copyright © 2025. Thomas W. Judson. All rights reserved' and describes the book as an open source textbook; the book's own colophon licence governs the book text.
The book's exercises are not copied. Corniversity exercises are original and labelled; any adaptation would be labelled adapted_with_attribution.
